subsample_labels_random_sampling: subsample labels from a tensor by randomly selecting positive and negative examples with a target positive fraction
subsample_labels_positive_negative_indic: return positive and negative index tensors from a label vector using subsample_labels with a specified background label
subsample_labels_object_detection: use subsample_labels to balance positive foreground and negative background samples for object detection anchor training
review_subsample_labels: review the subsample_labels function to understand how it handles cases with insufficient positive or negative examples
test_subsample_labels_edge_cases: test subsample_labels with edge cases where there are not enough positive or negative labels to fill the requested sample size
